feeds.title: Barcelona Life Blog
feeds.description: Discover the best hotels, restaurants, nightlife, shops, culture and things to do in Barcelona. Buy tickets for Gaudi's top attractions, book city tours and reserve day trips in Catalonia, Spain. Barcelona travel guide with local life and events.

feeds.title: Piccavey
feeds.description: Molly began writing about Spain in 2011. Based in Andalusia. Molly is passionate about the Mediterranean lifestyle, historic sites, and Spanish food. Living like a local in Spain since 1998, she is fluent in Spanish. Molly enjoys sharing her travel tips and recommendations on this blog.

feeds.title: Citylife Madrid Blog
feeds.description: Citylife Madrid provides you with everything you need during your stay in Madrid, from accommodation & events to cultural activities, trips and parties! The Citylife Madrid Blog helps you to explore and enjoy the city of Madrid. get the best out of here: be part of it!

feeds.title: Barcelona Navigator
feeds.description: Barcelona Navigator is a city guide covering local events, hotels, restaurants, nightlife, and shopping.

feeds.title: Valencian
feeds.description: Valencia News is an online news site that features the most recent headlines from Valencia, La Comunidad Valenciana, and Spain in general. We publish not only news about daily life in Valencia, but also news about business, tourism, real estate, entertainment, lifestyle, and events, with a special focus on foreigners living here as well as people preparing to make the move.

feeds.title: Sunshine and Siestas
feeds.description: One girl's journey from the skyscrapers of Chicago to the olive groves on Southern Spain. Information on travel, culture, food, teaching English, and navigating a bilingual relationship.

feeds.title: Spain by Hanne
feeds.description: Hanne Olsen's Spain by Hanne aims to inspire you to travel in Spain with awareness, build a bridge between the Spanish and Danish cultures, and create a connection with the locals. Here you will find informative and thought-provoking travel inspiration that also inspires you to experience the country from new angles.

feeds.title: My Showroom
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Priscila Betancort. My Showroom is a place where I share myr day-to-day fashion, beauty and lifestyle trends.

feeds.title: Esturirafi
feeds.description: We are Rut and Nahir: sisters, Galicians and authors of the Eco Blog Esturirafi, a space that was born in 2014 in which we talk about ecological, sustainable and healthy life.

feeds.title: Ohla Living Lifestyle Blog
feeds.description: A lifestyle, travel, food, and family blog in Valencia, Spain. Ohla Living covers topics that showcase what it's like living in the part of the Mediterranean. Ohla Living is a blog for families who appreciate culture, the simple things as well as making the most of family time.

feeds.title: Family Life in Spain Blog
feeds.description: We are a British family, living and loving life in the beautiful village of Mijas Pueblo, in Malaga, Andalucía in the South of Spain. We have travelled and lived in many places during our lives and have finally found our 'home'. Our website is jam packed full of information about moving to Spain, living in Spain and our family holidays.

feeds.title: Style in Madrid
feeds.description: The latest from Elena Vidal blog, Civil Engineer & Fashion Blogger that features outfits, trends, lifestyle and beauty tips.

feeds.title: Sojuls Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Juls. Thanks for visiting my blog. I am an architect, fashion & travel lover based in Madrid. I create content and I show all the nice and interesting things I find.

feeds.title: Mom in Madrid
feeds.description: Join Katrina in this journey of cooking, DIYing, interior designing, and adapting to a new country.

feeds.title: Barcelona Hacks
feeds.description: On my Barcelona travel blog, I've utilized my local experience to craft articles with hotel tips, top itineraries, best restaurants, tourist passes, must-see attractions, and everything else you need to enjoy the city to the fullest.

feeds.title: All That She Wants
feeds.description: Hello! I am Erea Louro, I am 28 years old and I am a fashion stylist. In my blog I share my looks, my inspiration and everything that I like and I am finding in my day to day.
